correctness.rationale: All eight triple types and four endpoint pairs were exactly reduced to six distinct profile increments; the six-feature transfer expression is exact for any length n>=2. Denominator/numerator degree bounds (256/257) imply each claimed rational generating function is certified by exact coefficient comparison through degree 279, beyond the 272 cross-multiplication bound; a second program directly enumerates every word through length 14. The asymptotic 1/8 follows from endpoint-transition probability and exponentially small omission of four motifs. No finite enumeration is substituted for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Deletion under pair-frequency observation is a natural profile channel distinct from full-word deletion. The theorem supplies a complete six-class distribution at every length, an exact first saturation threshold n=9, and an interpretable limiting 1/8 frequency. This provides sharp channel ambiguity statistics beyond a routine local error vector bound or finite table; no unsupported extension to multi-deletion or other alphabets is claimed.
